```{r} 
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(openxlsx)

# colour palette 
my_cols <- brewer.pal(n=5, "Spectral")


## feature and cell count function

FeatCellCount <- function(seuratObj){dim(seuratObj)
              }


```



#segregate list of cell cycle markers into G2/M and S

```{r}
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
```

#assign cell-cycle scores

```{r}
HH28B <- CellCycleScoring(HH28B, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = TRUE)

```

#visualise distribution
```{r}

png("cell_cycle_distribution.png", width = 2600, height = 2000)

plots <- RidgePlot(HH28B,
                   features = c("PCNA","TOP2A","MCM6","MKI67"), ncol = 2,
                   cols = c("S" = "orange", "G1" = "forestgreen", "G2M" = "steelblue4"),
                   combine = FALSE)

plots <- lapply(plots, function(p) p +
                  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 40),
                        axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
                        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
                        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
                        legend.text = element_text(size = 30)) +
                  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 30))))

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)

dev.off()

```

#update how clusters are ordered in metadata to ensure uniform ordering across all sample reports
```{r}
# Update the identity of the Seurat object and define the new order of groups
HH28B@meta.data$Phase <- factor(HH28B@meta.data$Phase, levels = c("G1", "S", "G2M"))


# Reassign identity with the new order
Idents(HH28B) <- HH28B@meta.data$Phase
```



# cell-cycle scoring distribution plot

```{r}

DimPlot(HH28B, cols = c("S" = "orange", "G1" = "forestgreen", "G2M" = "steelblue4", group_by = "Phase")) 
ggsave("../plots/cc_plot.png", dpi = 400)


```



```{r}
saveRDS(HH28B, file = "sObj_5_CC.RDS")
```
